note: Real cross-border movement is documented, but it is an EXPORT from India to Nepal, not an import into India: the row lists Pharmegic as supplier, Raxaul (India) as origin and Birgunj (Nepal) as destination, B/L 4886511, dated 2025-09-08. The claimed industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is also inconsistent with the observed product line (pharma packaging / gelatin capsules), so the industry label should be treated as unverified.
